memo.summary: Shadow/context-only deliberation as of 2026-09-18: the headline is RISK_ON with a calm, receding risk radar and normalizing volatility, but confirmation quality is incomplete. The confirmed US Q3 label is unsupported by its own current axes: raw signs indicate Q2 and the transition counter is only 1/7. Liquidity is supportive but mechanical and transient rather than Fed-asset-led; the RRP buffer is exhausted. Market participation remains weak: 31.6% of members are above their 50-day average, breadth divergence is present, no confirmation chip is fresh, and the global-breadth scare remains elevated at 81.6. Therefore this is a tension requiring observation, not a new signal, trade, score, ranking, or escalation. Factor evidence is immature: only nine panel dates, history floor unmet, no Pair G records, and no factor-attention track record. One falsifiable context hypothesis was registered for later grading: dual FX/rates-credit contradiction plus raw/confirmed quad mismatch should precede a transition to the raw quad within seven sessions at a hit rate of at least 60% over at least 20 independent episodes.
what_fired: World-state headline changed back to RISK_ON while the risk radar moved from caution to calm; 21-day measured pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, explicitly an early contextual reading rather than an edge.
Risk-radar de-escalation is eligible: growth, internals, and bubble intensities receded, while the 21-day drawdown estimate stayed flat.
Dealer gamma changed from short to long and volatility is normalizing; these remain display/context observations.
Three shadow attention records were written: US regime label versus cross-asset evidence; risk-on headline versus weak participation; and expired open Master Brain theses requiring ledger review.
A seven-session regime/cross-asset hypothesis was registered with a pre-committed hit-rate gate; it carries no present authority.
memo.contradictions_review: Five current contradiction edges were reviewed. The central macro conflict is that FX and rates-credit both contradict confirmed Q3 while the regime's own raw axes read Q2. Separately, the risk-on/calm headline conflicts with weak breadth, absent fresh market-confirmation chips, and persistent elevated global-breadth stress. The briefing also contains 38 ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences. Six buy-lane names have rising put skew, but that options evidence is display-only and the relevant bullish skew-deceleration prior is unsupported, so it can only de-escalate confidence. Pair G factor contradictions are unavailable because the panel has only nine dates and requires at least 60. Several Master Brain theses remain marked open despite passed check-by dates; the China-overweight thesis now faces China Q4, contracting liquidity, and mature China risk-off context, while a long-Treasury thesis has one stated falsifier leg met by the 2.68% real 10-year yield. These are attention conflicts, not directional calls.
decaying_families: Policy claims remain unarmed and show negative signed excess across available 5-, 21-, and 63-day samples; the evidence is thin or the allocation test is vacuous.
Radar claims are unarmed and exhibit negative shrunken signed excess on pooled 5-, 21-, and 63-day horizons despite large samples; current calm readings should not be treated as alpha.
Stock-desk and thematic-desk 63-day families show persistently negative signed excess across pooled and regime slices; their arming tests are vacuous.
Alt-data is held because pooled out-of-sample performance remains negative; demand-chain, policy-intent, narrative-brain, and desk-radar families are still accruing or underpowered.
Factor composite is non-tradeable: no scorecard survivors, negative IC for investment, low-volatility, low-beta, and composite legs, with only nine current panel dates.

The spine sample returned was dominated by Canadian-board unsigned-MFE proxy records and repeated horizons; it is unsuitable for inferring recent general claim quality without narrower family and date controls.
deserves_operator: US regime-label reconciliation: confirmed Q3 versus raw Q2 and simultaneous FX/rates-credit contradiction. Clear if Q3 transitions to Q2 within seven sessions or both contradictions disappear for three consecutive sessions.

Participation-quality tension: RISK_ON/calm versus 31.6% above the 50-day average, breadth divergence, zero fresh confirmation chips, and global-breadth stress at 81.6. Clear if breadth exceeds 50% and market_confirmed becomes true; retain if breadth stays below 40% or global breadth remains above 75.

Master Brain ledger hygiene: every displayed open thesis has a check-by date no later than 2026-09-04. Clear when expired theses are scored, retired, or explicitly extended with new timestamped falsifiers.

Data-quality caution: the factor panel is below its history floor, Pair G is dormant, options-flow history is immature, and multiple China/HK sources failed. Absence of contradictions in those planes is incomplete coverage, not agreement.

Liquidity quality: the apparent tailwind is mechanical and transient, RRP is exhausted, and the underlying 20-day net-liquidity change is negative despite the expanding overlay. Watch for reserve-sensitive deterioration; do not treat this as an originating input.
